is_admob_enabled.description: Master switch: true = ads enabled across the app, false = turn off all ads

is_test_mode.description: true = use Google test ads (safe for development), false = serve live production ads

android_banner_prod_id.description: Live production AdMob Banner ad unit ID for Android

android_interstitial_prod_id.description: Live production AdMob Interstitial ad unit ID for Android

android_native_prod_id.description: Live production AdMob Native ad unit ID for Android

android_rewarded_prod_id.description: Live production AdMob Rewarded ad unit ID for Android

android_app_open_prod_id.description: Live production AdMob App Open ad unit ID for Android

enable_home_banner_ad.description: Show bottom banner ad on home screen

enable_home_native_ad.description: Show native ad tile inside the home project grid

enable_language_native_ad.description: Show native ad on language selection screen

enable_template_native_ad.description: Show native ad inside templates gallery

enable_template_details_native_ad.description: Show native ad inside template preview details screen

enable_project_native_ad.description: Show native ad on new canvas creation dialog

enable_navigation_interstitial_ad.description: Show full-screen interstitial ad between major screen transitions (capped by cooldown)

enable_app_open_ads.description: Show App Open ad when resuming or opening the application

enable_rewarded_ads.description: Allow users to watch rewarded video ads to unlock special templates
